video_title: Practice Media Availability with Kenrich Williams | October 17, 2026 | OKC Thunder

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on the team's focus heading into the regular season
quotes.excerpt: the real thing is Tuesday, so
quotes.quote: I think just refocusing, knowing that this is the real thing, Tuesday. It's when it really starts and you get a little bit of pop and you know, okay, it's about to start up. And that's not to say that you don't take preseason serious, but the real thing is Tuesday, so.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams says the Thunder are ready to flip the switch for the regular season opener on Tuesday. He notes that while preseason is important, the real work starts now.

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on the potential of the team's younger players
quotes.excerpt: They got potential to to really help out this year for sure.
quotes.quote: It's been good. It's been good. They shown flashes of greatness. They got potential to to really help out this year for sure. I think that's going to benefit not only them, but the team as well, getting those game reps and just going out there and playing freely.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams likes what he is seeing from the young Thunder players. He says they have shown flashes of greatness and have the potential to really help the team this year.

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on his role as a veteran leader for the team
quotes.excerpt: I don't try to force it at all, it just comes naturally.
quotes.quote: I take major pride in that. That's something that I don't try to force it at all, it just comes naturally. Either guys gravitate towards me or I gravitate towards any of the new guys, and that's just me trying to be a good teammate and a good person and just giving them game on what I've learned and what I've been through on and off the court.
quotes.social_post: Veteran leadership is a natural process for Kenrich Williams. He says he takes pride in mentoring the new guys and sharing what he has learned on and off the court.

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on the impact of seeing a teammate go down
quotes.excerpt: You never want to see anybody go down, whether that's your teammate or the opposing team.
quotes.quote: It sucks. It just gives you a bad feeling. You never want to see anybody go down, whether that's your teammate or the opposing team. And especially for a guy like him, a rookie who was playing pretty good, and it just sucks for a guy like that. So my prayers and thoughts are definitely with him and we're always keeping in touch with him during this process.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams shares his thoughts on a teammate suffering an injury. He says it sucks to see anyone go down, especially a rookie who was playing well.

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on Chet Holmgren's physical and mental growth
quotes.excerpt: He puts the work in this summer. I'm excited to see his growth.
quotes.quote: He just looks good, man. Physically, mentally, looks good. The thing about Chet is like, he loves adversity, and he's always been a hard worker ever since I met him. He's always been about basketball, so none of that has changed. He put the work in this summer. I'm excited to see his growth and what he's able to help us out with this year, because it's going to be something new this year as well. But he's a big part of who we are as a team and a big part of us winning, to be honest with you.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams says Chet Holmgren looks good physically and mentally heading into the season. He adds that Chet loves adversity and has put in the work this summer.

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on Chet Holmgren's professional approach to the spotlight
quotes.excerpt: He's the ultimate professional, ultimate teammate. He'll give you the shirt off his back.
quotes.quote: It's special. I have no idea what that feels like to be in the spotlight since a young kid, but he's handled it well. He's the ultimate professional, ultimate teammate. He'll give you the shirt off his back. He's that type of guy. The main thing has always stayed the main thing with Chet. It's always been about putting the work in and it's always been about basketball with him. When you got that combination and that mentality and that work ethic, the sky's the limit.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams praises Chet Holmgren for his professional approach to the spotlight. He says the main thing has always stayed the main thing with Chet, which is basketball.

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams predicts a big season for Chet Holmgren
quotes.excerpt: Chet is going to be the one to make the biggest jump this year.
quotes.quote: Out of everybody, I think Chet is going to be the one to make the biggest jump this year. I'm calling it right now. He's had a great training camp. He's gotten better, stronger, and he's always been one of those guys you can count on, even with his age. He's going to be really good this year and he's going to help us out a lot this year, especially having more responsibility.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams is calling it now. He believes Chet Holmgren is going to be the one to make the biggest jump for the Thunder this year.

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on his desire to retire with the Thunder
quotes.excerpt: I always say that I want to retire here in OKC, and that's I mean that.
quotes.quote: Definitely grateful to be back. Definitely grateful and appreciative that the front office and coach was on board with that. I always say that I want to retire here in OKC, and that's I mean that. The ability to be able to win games and play on the highest level, that's what we're doing it for right now.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams says he is grateful to be back with the Thunder and admits he wants to retire in OKC.

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on his readiness to contribute regardless of minutes
quotes.excerpt: I've always been a guy that that just takes what I'm given.
quotes.quote: I'm not sure. I've always been a guy that that just takes what I'm given. Whether that's 20 minutes or 10 minutes, I'm just grateful to be out there on the court. And when I get on the court, I'm going to make an impact. I feel that way. I feel strongly about that, no matter what I get.
quotes.social_post: Regardless of his role or minutes, Kenrich Williams says he is ready to make an impact whenever he gets on the court.

quotes.speaker: Kenrich Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Kenrich Williams on the professional mindset required for the regular season
quotes.excerpt: As a pro, you have to be ready. And that's what I try to at least.
quotes.quote: I think pretty much it's stayed the same every year. Coming into the summer, you got to work on your game. You got to get a lot of shots up and you got to be able to also get up and down and play, play freely, because you never know what role you're going to be called up on. As a pro, you have to be ready. And that's what I try to at least, I want people to, the young guys really to know, like as a professional, you have the responsibility, your responsibility is to stay ready, no matter what is throwing your way.
quotes.social_post: Kenrich Williams emphasizes the professional mindset required for the regular season, telling young players that their responsibility is to always stay ready.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach on the team's preparation for the 82-game season
quotes.excerpt: Practice had some pop to it today, for that reason.
quotes.quote: Yeah, it's good to get like a little flurry of games and then get back to practice time. We did that three separate times in this preseason. So, it was a game week, we didn't have a lot of practice time because of the condensed nature of the games. So now we can come and clean up what we need to clean up, install what we need to install in the last couple practices before we start.
quotes.social_post: The Thunder coaching staff is using the final days of practice to clean up and install systems before the regular season begins.

quotes.speaker: Unidentified speaker
quotes.summary_phrase: Coach on Chet Holmgren's physical conditioning and preseason performance
quotes.excerpt: He definitely got himself in a in a really good spot physically for camp.
quotes.quote: He definitely got himself in a in a really good spot physically for camp. No one enters camp at like a 10 out of 10, but you want to be in striking distance of that as you get closer to the beginning of the season and he did that. And then I thought he had a really good preseason in terms of experiences. Played a lot of minutes. He just played a couple road home back-to-backs. He just played three and four, which it happens, I think 18 times on our schedule, so he just got a taste of that kind of stuff in the preseason, which is something that he's going to obviously have to deal with when he gets in an NBA schedule.
quotes.social_post: The coaching staff says Chet Holmgren is in a good spot physically for the season and handled the rigors of the preseason schedule well.
